summary.en: Jazz combines neuroscience and oncology discovery with major new uses of existing medicines. Its late-stage portfolio includes zanidatamab, dordaviprone, cannabidiol and Vyxeos indication expansions alongside earlier acquired and collaborative candidates.

gaps: Company-wide phase totals were not verified; counts is null. No next milestone was verified for selected assets except the dated ACTION and JZP6979 forecasts.

One entry combines zanidatamab expansions: HERIZON-BTC-302 and EmpowHER are explicitly described as Phase 3 studies. The webpage summary labels first-line BTC regulatory, but no corresponding filing was verified, so phase 3 follows the described trials rather than inferring a submission.

First-line gastroesophageal zanidatamab is already approved according to Q3 results and is excluded as an investigational indication. Expanded Xywav dosing and cannabidiol capsules for existing indications are not new indications and are excluded.

Cannabidiol DEE and broader Vyxeos AML are retained under the revised major-new-indication rule. Lurbinectedin Ewing sarcoma is labelled Phase 3 in the chart but described as Phase 1/2 in the narrative; it is not added given unresolved staging and the ten-item limit.

JZP6979 Phase 2 follows the company pipeline classification; Q3 results describe KYRON as Phase 1b/2a. Origins for JZP3507, JZP815 and the newly selected zanidatamab, Vyxeos and cannabidiol entries were not verified in the accessible sources and are null.

JZP047 target and origin were not disclosed. Modalities for JZP3507, JZP815, JZP269, JZP047 and the liposomal Vyxeos combination were not assigned from unverified assumptions. Additional codes not stated are null.

The formerly cited Q3 filing download was inaccessible and has been removed from sources. The company pipeline, November overview and Q3 release were loaded; the SEC asset-purchase agreement supports acquired JZP898.
The May 6, 2026 SEC asset-purchase agreement is older than June 2026; it is used only for JZP898 ownership provenance, while clinical staging follows the November pipeline.

Final curl -sSIL checks were attempted for every cited URL on 2026-11-17. All 57 unique URLs returned HTTP 000 with curl exit 6 because this environment could not resolve hosts. Browser-loaded sources support the entries, but independent HTTP-status verification could not be completed.
